subject.title: fix: skip setup-only channel plugins in outbound resolution and drain pending deliveries on qqbot reconnect

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this PR's operation-aware delivery resolver and QQBot reconnect-drain behavior as the compatibility path for setup-only channel shells after reconnect?
rationale: The patch fixes a real message-loss regression, but it changes shared outbound resolution and queued replay behavior that can affect channel/plugin compatibility beyond QQBot.

options.title: Approve resolver split and drain
options.body: Land after owner review accepts that non-delivery callers stay on the shared resolver and delivery callers use the operation-aware gate.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Ask for a smaller variant or extra proof if owners want less shared resolver change or stronger replay evidence before accepting the risk.

options.title: Pause this PR
options.body: Leave the linked issue open and replace this branch if maintainers decide replay or resolver semantics need a different owner-boundary design.

recommendation.title: Approve resolver split and drain
recommendation.body: Land after owner review accepts that non-delivery callers stay on the shared resolver and delivery callers use the operation-aware gate.

likelyOwner.reason: Frank is the listed Gateway/Channels maintainer and has adjacent history on outbound resolver recovery.
